name: AWS S3
description: This plugin is used to pull a CSV or TXT file from an AWS S3 bucket and to generate EDM hashes of the pulled file. The file can be uncompressed or compressed as .gz or .zip.

configuration.label: Preview Sanitization Results
configuration.labelInfo: Preview the output of the first 20 records with sanitization performed on the data pulled from the AWS S3 bucket. If the 'Proceed without sanitization' is unchecked, only the Good file will be used for EDM Hash generation. In this case, review the Bad file and update the sanitization parameters or data source to prevent important records from being excluded. If the 'Proceed without sanitization' is checked, all data without sanitization will be used for EDM Hash generation.
configuration.name: sanity_results
